features.description: read_url MCP tool: fetch a specific URL and return clean text content
steps: Implement read_url tool using reqwest GET
Strip HTML tags, return clean text (max 50KB)
features.acceptance: curl a test URL via MCP returns clean text content

features.description: Moka LRU cache for web_search results (TTL 5min, max 1000 entries)
steps: Add moka dependency to bose-mcp Cargo.toml
Create cache key from query+params hash
Add cache hit/miss logging via tracing
Write unit test verifying cache hit returns same result
features.acceptance: Second identical query returns in <1ms with cache hit log

features.description: crawl_knowledge MCP tool: search + fetch + index pipeline
steps: Implement: SearXNG search -> fetch top N URLs -> extract text -> index to Tantivy
Add depth parameter (1-3) controlling how many URLs to fetch
features.acceptance: crawl_knowledge('rust async') indexes 5+ documents, local_search finds them

features.description: Install lefthook binary and activate git hooks
steps: Install lefthook via cargo install or binary download
Run lefthook install in project root
Verify commit-msg hook checks conventional commits
features.acceptance: git commit with bad format is rejected; cargo fmt violation blocks commit

features.description: GitHub Actions CI/CD: lint + test + build in parallel
steps: Job 1: cargo fmt --check + cargo clippy -- -D warnings
Job 3: cargo build --release + verify binary exists
Add SearXNG service container for integration tests
features.acceptance: Push to main triggers CI; all 3 jobs pass green

features.description: trait SearchBackend plugin system for pluggable data sources
steps: Define trait SearchBackend in bose-common with search() method
Refactor BoseSearchServer to use Vec<Box<dyn SearchBackend>>
Add backend selection logic in router
Write tests for each backend independently
features.acceptance: BoseSearchServer works with both backends via trait; adding new backend requires only impl SearchBackend
New agent reading CLAUDE.md knows to check .harness/ and bd ready

steps: Extract all Phase 2-5 features from MASTER_PLAN.md
